name: sgs/accordion
title: SGS Accordion
description: Expandable content sections â€” ideal for FAQs, product details, and policies. Optional FAQ Schema for SEO.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: Mirrors sgs/container's wrapper/grid split — typography migrated off native WP support onto the shared TypographyControls/sgs_typography_css_rule() mechanism (D971/D972), root prefix '' (fontSize/fontWeight/fontStyle/lineHeight); no letterSpacing/textTransform/textAlign/fontFamily control is offered, and no width/height/box-shadow/aspect-ratio attrs exist, so those remain honest gaps. The 12 ARRANGEMENT members also apply here (layer OUTER) and are resolved by the sibling `inner` element, not this one — same double-check pattern container's wrapper uses.

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Same composite wrapper grid capability as sgs/container (rendered via the shared SGS_Container_Wrapper, kind='layout'). Maps explicitly because this element declares no `prefix` — the default {prefix}{Suffix} convention cannot resolve a bare camelCase attribute (ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1). Members with no attribute on this block (display, order, overflow) remain honest gaps.

header.label: Item header
header._note: headerColour/headerBackground/headerFontWeight/headerGap/headerMinHeight style every accordion-item's header row via block context (providesContext). No independent header font-size or line-height control exists: both inherit from the accordion's own Typography panel, which reaches the header now that style.css holds no font-size or line-height hardcode on it, so the remaining text-cluster members are honest gaps. headerBackgroundGradient (colour-conformance preset-upgrade, 2026-09-06) bypasses the preset-slug mechanism entirely when set — see attribute description. headerBackgroundHover/HoverGradient (2026-09-06, FILL closeout) override the pre-existing hardcoded-default .sgs-accordion-item__header:hover rule in style.css. headerFontWeightOpen (2026-09-25) is a genuine third state ('open', not 'hover') — it paints the `[open]` attribute selector, the non-colour WCAG 1.4.1 signal alongside the open-state colour change — and overrides the pre-existing hardcoded-default open-state font-weight rule in style.css.

icon.label: Toggle icon
icon._note: iconColour paints the open/close chevron. openIcon/closeIcon (icon slug) and iconPosition are content/variant fields, not independent style controls, so only the colour member is mapped — the rest are honest gaps. `css:stroke` (D636/D644 icon/SVG gradient mechanism) explicit-mapped to iconColourGradient, added 2026-08-16 (Builder 4) — non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php). iconColourHover/iconColourHoverGradient (2026-09-06, colour-conformance closeout) mirror the same mechanism, consumed by sgs/accordion-item via block context exactly like the resting pair (providesContext below).

icon-ring.label: Toggle icon ring
icon-ring._note: The optional ring around the toggle icon, the iconCircle* family of sgs/notice-banner and sgs/trust-bar. Printed by sgs/accordion-item from block context on the item's `.sgs-accordion-item__icons` box (a circle, border-box); nothing prints while every member is empty. The glyph keeps the Icon size.

turning-icon.label: Turning toggle icon
turning-icon._note: The single toggle icon an item prints when it turns instead of cross-fading (`.sgs-accordion-item__icon-open--rotates`, printed by sgs/accordion-item when iconRotation is above 0 or this part holds an Entrance layer). A motion target only (Spec 38A FR-38A-53): an `entrance.base` with trigger State and state `expanded` turns it while the item is open; the item publishes `expanded` on its `<details>`. Colour and size stay on `icon`.

panel.label: Answer slide
panel._note: The browser-animated answer slot of every item. panelDuration and panelEasing time its open and close slide; empty keeps the theme tokens.

item.label: Accordion item
item._note: Each item's title + body content is rendered by the child `sgs/accordion-item` block, which owns its own typography controls — this element documents that ownership, mirroring sgs/quote's quote-body.

filterbar.label: Filter bar
filterbar._note: The search box and chip wrapper. It has no setting of its own; the chips, count and empty message inside it carry the settings.

chip.label: Filter chip
chip._note: A chip never takes motion. Chip text size is filterChipFontSize; the rest of the chip typography follows the accordion's own Typography panel.

chips.label: Filter chip row
chips._note: One row of chips. A one-row setting also scrolls the row sideways and keeps each chip at its own width (filterChipsWrap).

searchicon.label: Filter search icon
searchicon._note: A Lucide icon inside the search box's start edge (filterSearchIcon, filterSearchIconColour, filterSearchIconSize); the input's start padding clears it.

empty.label: Filter empty message
empty._note: Inherits the accordion's text colour and typography; the message and link are content (filterEmptyMessage, filterEmptyLink).

scrollToOpened.description: When a visitor opens an item, scroll its header below the sticky site header unless it is already fully in view. Reduced motion jumps instead of scrolling smoothly.

meaning.what: Scrolls an opened item's header to just below the sticky site header unless it is already fully in view.

scrollToOpenedGap.description: Extra space between the site header and the scrolled-to item header. Added to the published site header height (--sgs-header-height).

meaning.what: Sets the extra space between the site header and the scrolled-to item header.
meaning.trigger: an item opening, when scroll-to-opened is on

accordionStyle.description: Visual preset (bordered | flush | card). Renamed from `style` 2026-08-30 — a block attribute named `style` shadows WP's reserved style object, silently disabling this block's colour, spacing, typography and border supports.

filterEnabled.description: Show a search box and topic chips above the items, with a live count and an empty message. Items carry a Category.

filterSearch.description: Show the search box in the filter bar. It matches the item heading and its answer.

filterSearchLabel.description: The search box's label (read by screen readers, not painted).

filterSearchPlaceholder.description: The placeholder shown in the empty search box.

filterChips.description: Show one chip per item Category, first-seen order, after the All chip.

filterChipsLabel.description: The chip group's accessible name (read by screen readers, not painted).

filterAllLabel.description: The label on the chip that shows every item.

filterCountTemplate.description: The count line when the count is not one. {count} is replaced by the number shown.

filterCountSingular.description: The count line when exactly one item is shown. {count} is replaced by the number shown.

filterEmptyMessage.description: The message shown when nothing matches. Empty prints a neutral message.

filterEmptyLink.description: An optional link after the empty message: {url, label}.

filterChipColour.description: Chip text colour (palette slug or CSS colour). Empty keeps the theme default.

filterChipBackground.description: Chip background (palette slug or CSS colour). Empty keeps the theme default.

filterChipBorderColour.description: Chip border colour (palette slug or CSS colour). Empty keeps the theme default.

filterChipRadius.description: Chip corner radius (a CSS length). Empty keeps the pill shape.

filterChipColourPressed.description: Text colour of the selected chip. Empty keeps the theme default.

filterChipBackgroundPressed.description: Background of the selected chip. Empty keeps the theme default.

filterCountColour.description: Colour of the count line. Empty inherits the text colour.

filterChipFontSize.description: Chip text size per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length. Empty inherits the accordion's text size.

filterChipFontFamily.description: Font family of the filter chips: a theme font preset slug or a CSS font-family list. Empty inherits the accordion's font.

filterSearchFontFamily.description: Font family of the filter search box text: a theme font preset slug or a CSS font-family list. Empty inherits the accordion's font.

filterSearchIconOffset.description: Distance from the search box's start edge to the search icon, one CSS length (for example "1.25rem"). The text clears the icon by the same distance. Empty = 1rem.

filterChipShadow.description: Shadow shape of every chip while resting (the shared layered shadow control). Empty = no shadow.

filterChipShadowColour.description: Colour of the resting chip's shadow.

filterChipSelectedShadow.description: Shadow shape of the selected chip (the shared layered shadow control). Empty = no shadow.

filterChipSelectedShadowColour.description: Colour of the selected chip's shadow.

filterChipSelectedOffsetX.description: Horizontal offset of the selected chip (CSS length, e.g. "-2px"). Empty = no shift.

filterChipSelectedOffsetY.description: Vertical offset of the selected chip (CSS length, e.g. "-2px"). Empty = no shift.

filterChipsWrap.description: Chip row wrapping per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each "wrap" (chips drop onto further rows) or "nowrap" (one row that scrolls sideways). Empty = the stylesheet's wrapping.

filterChipsJustify.description: Chip row alignment per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each "left", "center" or "right". Empty = the stylesheet's start alignment.

filterChipsPadding.description: Chip row padding as a per-device box {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a {top,right,bottom,left} box. Gives a scrolling row room for the chips' shadow and lift. Empty = no padding.

filterSearchBackground.description: Search box fill (palette slug or CSS colour). Empty keeps it transparent.

filterSearchMaxWidth.description: Search box maximum width per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length. Empty = the full width of the filter bar.

filterSearchAlign.description: Where a search box narrower than the bar sits, per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each "left", "center" or "right". Empty = the start edge.

filterSearchHeight.description: Search box minimum height per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length. Empty = the stylesheet's 44px.

filterSearchPadding.description: Search box padding as a per-device box {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a {top,right,bottom,left} box. Empty = the stylesheet's 1rem each side, widened at the start when an icon is set.

filterSearchFontSize.description: Search box text size per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length. Empty inherits the accordion's text size.

filterSearchShadow.description: Shadow shape of the search box (the shared layered shadow control). Empty = no shadow.

filterSearchShadowColour.description: Colour of the search box's shadow.

filterSearchIcon.description: Lucide icon slug printed inside the start edge of the search box (for example 'search'). Empty = no icon.

filterSearchIconColour.description: Colour of the search icon (palette slug or CSS colour). Empty inherits the text colour.

filterSearchIconSize.description: Width and height of the search icon as one CSS length. Empty = 1.25rem.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the accordion's border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.

headerFontWeight.description: Item header (title) font weight when closed, relayed to sgs/accordion-item via block context. Default 600 matches the pre-existing hardcoded style.css value.

headerColourOpen.description: Item header text colour while the item is open (palette slug). Empty keeps the stylesheet's open-state colour (primary).

headerBackgroundOpen.description: Item header background while the item is open (palette slug). Empty keeps the stylesheet's open-state background (surface-alt).

itemBackgroundOpen.description: Fill of the whole item (header and answer) while it is open (palette slug or any colour). Empty leaves the item unfilled.

itemShadow.description: Shadow shape round every item while closed. Composed with itemShadowColour. Empty draws no shadow.

itemShadowColour.description: Colour of itemShadow (palette slug or any colour).

itemShadowOpen.description: Shadow shape round the item while it is open. Composed with itemShadowOpenColour. Empty keeps the closed shadow.

itemShadowOpenColour.description: Colour of itemShadowOpen (palette slug or any colour).

headerFontWeightOpen.description: Item header (title) font weight when the item is open — the non-colour WCAG 1.4.1 signal alongside the open-state colour change. Default 700 matches the pre-existing hardcoded style.css value.

headerBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting every accordion-item's header row background via background-image (colour-conformance preset-upgrade, 2026-09-06). Non-empty wins over headerBackground's theme-preset-slug resolution entirely — bypasses the var(--wp--preset--color--{slug}) mechanism, since a gradient cannot be a swatch name. Relayed to accordion-item via block context (sgs/accordionHeaderBackgroundGradient).

headerBackgroundHover.description: Header row background colour on :hover/:focus-visible (colour-conformance FILL closeout, 2026-09-06). The header row already has a real :hover rule (style.css .sgs-accordion-item__header:hover) with hardcoded theme-default colours — this control lets the operator override it. Relayed to accordion-item via block context (sgs/accordionHeaderBackgroundHover).

headerBackgroundHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the header row's :hover background. Non-empty wins over headerBackgroundHover. Relayed to accordion-item via block context (sgs/accordionHeaderBackgroundHoverGradient).

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the toggle chevron's stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time (D636/D644).

iconColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the toggle chevron's stroke on hover instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover at render time.

headerColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the accordion-item header text instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over headerColour (colour-conformance text-colour trio closeout, 2026-09-07).

headerColourHover.description: Header row text colour on :hover/:focus-visible (colour-conformance text-colour trio closeout, 2026-09-07). Relayed to accordion-item via block context.

headerColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the header row text on :hover. Non-empty wins over headerColourHover. Relayed to accordion-item via block context.

headerPadding.description: Item header padding as a per-device box {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a {top,right,bottom,left} box. Empty = the stylesheet's 16px 20px (14px 16px under 600px).

headerGap.description: Gap between the item header's title and its toggle icon, per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a spacing preset slug ("20") or a custom length ("12px"), validated by sgs_css_length_value(). Empty = the stylesheet's 12px.

headerMinHeight.description: Item header minimum height in px, per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}. Empty = the stylesheet's 44px, which meets the WCAG 2.5.5 touch target. A client may set less where the context warrants it; 44px is the default, not a floor.

contentPadding.description: Item answer padding as a per-device box {desktop,tablet,mobile}. Empty = the stylesheet's 0 20px 16px (0 16px 14px under 600px).

iconSize.description: Toggle icon width and height in px, per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}. Empty = 24px.

iconStrokeWidth.description: Stroke width of the toggle icon's lines. 2 is the Lucide default; lower is finer, higher is bolder. Clamped to 0.25 to 4.

iconRotation.description: Degrees the open icon turns when the item opens. Non-zero prints only the open icon and rotates it; 0 keeps both icons and cross-fades them. Ignored when the Turning toggle icon part holds an Entrance layer (Spec 38A FR-38A-53): the layer then prints the single icon and sets the angle and timing.

iconCircleSize.description: Ring around the toggle icon: its diameter in px, per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}. Empty = no sized ring; the icon box keeps the Icon size.

iconCircleBorderWidth.description: Ring around the toggle icon: border width as a {top,right,bottom,left} box. Empty = no ring border.

iconCircleBorderColour.description: Ring around the toggle icon: border colour. Empty = the current text colour.

iconCircleBackground.description: Ring around the toggle icon: background colour. Empty = transparent.

iconCircleBorderColourOpen.description: Ring border colour while the item is open. Empty keeps the closed colour.

iconCircleBackgroundOpen.description: Ring background colour while the item is open. Empty keeps the closed background.

panelDuration.description: Milliseconds (1 to 3000) the answer takes to slide open and shut. 0 keeps the theme's medium speed.

panelEasing.description: Curve of the answer's open and close slide, from the shared motion easing list (includes/helpers-motion-easing.php). Empty keeps the theme's default curve.

panelEasingCustom.description: A hand-typed cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) curve, read only when panelEasing is 'custom'.
